label: RackStation RS1221+ 2U 8-bay NAS
description: 2U 8-bay rackmount NAS with four 1GbE RJ45 ports and one PCIe 3.0 x8 (x4 link) slot. That slot takes 10GbE or 25GbE network cards, which are add-in and not part of the onboard count.
notes: Onboard: 4x 1GbE RJ45. The 10/25GbE path is a PCIe 3.0 x8 (x4 electrical) slot - E10G18-T1, E10G30-T2/F2 or a 25GbE card - so those ports are add-in, not onboard. Rear console port is serial, not Ethernet. No BMC.
